entries.claim: This setting prints the 47-word collecta proper w001–w047, followed by the distinct abbreviated cue “Per Dóminum.” The full supplied ending and Amen are not printed at this proper locus.

locator.section: RG115a complete ending and Amen wording; same-edition accented common stem and terminal typography

entries.claim: RG115a supplies the Father-directed Per Dominum ending w048–w068 and Amen w069. Its literal rubric formula is unaccented. Same-edition p.123 controls matching accented formula words, and p.226 controls the accented four-word terminal and separately marked Amen period. These controls do not make the proper page a full-ending witness or establish response actors, singing, or larger-group conclusion distribution.

locator.section: RG115a; this setting’s full ending and Amen

entries.claim: This setting’s own RG115a supplies its complete ad-patrem ending and Amen, w048–w069. Its literal accents, punctuation and Amen list semicolon are retained. Formula wording alone does not establish response actors, singing or a rule for grouped orations.
